children: Commercial vehicle maker Tata Motors on Thursday announced it will increase its vehicle prices by up to 1 per cent from October 1.
The revision is being undertaken to offset the rise in commodity and other input costs, the company said in a statement.
The price increase will differ depending on the vehicle models and variants, it said.

title: Tata Motors to raise vehicle prices by up to 1% from Oct 1
